claims.population: The infobox gives an estimated 791,200 residents for Maiduguri (2022 projection).
claims.climate: Maiduguri is classified as hot semi-arid (BSh); the cool season runs from about 20 July to 23 September; monthly rainfall peaks at about 230 mm in August and is near zero from November to March.
claims.economy: Maiduguri is the principal trading hub for north-eastern Nigeria, and its economy is largely based on services and trade with a small share of manufacturing.
